NYC Department of Finance (DOF) is responsible for administering the tax revenue laws of the city fairly, efficiently, and transparently to instill public confidence and encourage compliance while providing exceptional customer service. DOF’s Finance Information Technology (FIT) Division designs, builds, and supports all facets of DOF’s computer systems, including hardware, software, applications, infrastructure, telephone, and data security. FIT delivers and administers tax-related payment programs for the City of New York by providing the information technology solutions needed to achieve its mission of collecting revenue while ensuring an efficient and improved customer experience. FIT is also responsible for the systems and websites which enable citywide payments, land records, property assessment, parking adjudications, customer service, and the Sheriff’s public safety work. Responsibilities FIT’s Network and VOIP support team is responsible for all aspects of the network connectivity for the agency, which is comprised of 11 sites, 300+ servers that are responsible for $300+B in tax revenues, keeping the systems operational within the 5 business centers and multiple public-facing websites. The Network & VoIP Team is seeking a Network Systems Administrator. Reporting to the Director of Network/VOIP Infrastructure, the selected candidate’s duties and responsibilities will include, but not be limited to the following: Develop dashboards and network maps (as it relates to management network platforms) for a quick snapshot into the real-time connectivity of all DOF's Cisco switching and routing network devices. Ensure that the DOF network is readily available to the users to perform their daily functions and provide quick resolution to user access issues. Install various Cisco Catalyst 9400, 4500, 3800 series access switches (that connect to DOF's core Nexus 9500 series switches), in DOF's wire rooms to provide LAN/WAN access to all DOF applications to end users moving into a newly created LAN segment. Configure Cisco network access switches (that connect to DOF's core Nexus 9500 Cisco series switches), to provide LAN/WAN access to all DOF applications to existing users on a LAN segment and move new users into a newly created LAN segment. Configure core routers & switches that connect to OTI’s CityNet. Design and create new VLAN subnets on DOF's access and core Cisco switches, to provide LAN/WAN access to special units. Troubleshoot and resolve all LAN/WAN DOF connectivity issues as they relate to IP, redundancy, EIGRP, RIP and RIPv2, OSPF, VLANs, cabling, printing, and security, and the OTI cloud. Develop and implement advanced network management programs and services in support of DOF’s Wide Area Network. Troubleshoot VoIP related issues. May liaise with vendors for technical support. Diagnose Network connectivity problems and communicate technical issues to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Perform related work of a highly complex, technical nature in LAN/WAN Network design. Provide 4th level technical support to both DOF and OTI. Additional Information In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification document form upon hire. However, all candidates must have at least one year of satisfactory (not classroom based) full-time information technology experience as described in "1" above. Note: In addition to meeting the minimum Qualification Requirements: Incumbents may be required to update existing and/or obtain additional professional industry-standard certification(s) for current and future technical environments(s) in which they may be assigned to work, as determined by the employing agency.
